intro: SkyGrid will use a proposed 5×5 probability–impact model. The numerical model is a prioritization aid, not permission to ignore low-probability catastrophic events. Safety-critical risks receive mandatory controls regardless of arithmetic score. Table 12 lists the proposed risk register; scores are planning judgments, not measured probabilities.

risks.response: Early Transport Canada engagement; alternate operating concepts.
Multiple site options; conditional agreements before capital release.
Independent estimates; contingency; phased scope; value engineering.

risks.risk: Technology purchased too early becomes obsolete
risks.response: Modular architecture; wave procurement; open interfaces where feasible.

risks.risk: External partner demand weaker than forecast
risks.response: Written commitments / pilots before expansion; diversify sectors.
SMS, qualified operators, test envelopes, maintenance, incident procedures, insurance.

risks.risk: Cyberattack compromises C2 systems or data
risks.response: Threat risk assessment; segmentation; secure C2; access/logging/response.
Privacy by design; minimize collection; access/retention/sharing controls.
Early recruitment; industry adjuncts; training and succession.
Early engagement; alternate sites; clear operating/data rules.
Long-lead register; early market sounding; multiple qualified suppliers.

risks.risk: Technical platform poorly integrated into academics
risks.response: Five-program minimum; faculty design participation; pilot learning projects.
